items.title: AI trade under pressure: Why investors should think differently
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi examines the recent pullback in AI stocks and challenges investors to ask a different question: "What could go right?" As Wall Street grows increasingly skeptical of the AI trade ahead of Anthropic (ANTH.PVT)'s anticipated IPO, Sozzi explores why investors may be overlooking the technology's long-term growth potential and the opportunities that could emerge from the sell-off.
